title: State Income Tax Withholding on Income Annuities Arrears Installments
content:
State tax is withheld from an arrears installment on an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract only when federal tax is withheld from it and federal tax was withheld from the contract's installments falling due in the twelve months before the payment date. When both hold:

| State of issue | State tax withheld |
|---|---|
| Iowa, Minnesota, North Carolina or Vermont | State flat rate of **5% (0.05)** of the taxable part, rounded to the cent |
| Delaware, New York or Oklahoma | Alternative state rate of **4% (0.04)** of the taxable part, rounded to the cent |

Otherwise no state tax is withheld from the arrears installment.

The twelve-month test reads the federal tax withheld amounts on the installments issued on the contract whose payment dates fall in the twelve months before the payment date; it is met when that total is more than zero.

### Combinations for a contract issued in Iowa (hypothetical)

| Federal tax withheld from the arrears installment | Federal tax withheld from installments due in the prior twelve months | State tax |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 5% of the taxable part |
| Yes | No | None |
| No | Yes | None |
| No | No | None |

*Hypothetical figure.* Taxable part $900.00 on a Delaware contract, both conditions met: state tax $36.00. The same installment on a Minnesota contract: $45.00. On a Florida contract: none.
